newsitem.title: FRANCE: BNP requotes more than 10 pct higher.
newsitem.headline: BNP requotes more than 10 pct higher.

text.p: Shares in Banque Nationale de Paris requoted more than 10 percent higher than their opening level on Wednesday after a 15-minute suspension triggered by a hefty surge amid renewed bank sector restructuring speculation.
BNP shares stood 11.06 percent up at 277.2 francs at 1035 GMT after hitting a year high of 282.0 francs.
Shares in the smaller CCF bank had been suspended temporarily a little earlier and were trading 11.4 percent higher at 291.3 francs at 1038 GMT, after also hitting a year high of 300.0 francs.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was meanwhile surging and hit an all-time high a little earlier of 3,010.37 points. It was up 2.89 percent at 3,005.70 points at 1040 GMT.
